ocrRegions.text: 巾我放在這喔！換洗衣物跟毛
ocrRegions.translatedText: I put a towel here! I’ve also laid out a change of clothes and a towel...

ocrRegions.text: 的~量先幫妳弄乾制服我也會盡
ocrRegions.translatedText: I’ll do my best to dry your uniform first~

ocrRegions.text: 該很冷才對雨淋濕了，應明明自己也被
ocrRegions.translatedText: Even though you got soaked in the rain yourself, you must be freezing.

ocrRegions.text: 族館、天文館的票他還幫我買了水
ocrRegions.translatedText: He even bought tickets to the aquarium and planetarium...

ocrRegions.text: 的那一側靠近車道總是走在
ocrRegions.translatedText: He always walks on the side closer to the road...

ocrRegions.text: 的味道呢阿宅君身上這件T恤有
ocrRegions.translatedText: This T-shirt of yours smells like you, Otaku-kun...

ocrRegions.text: 給我的情侶手環還買了成對
ocrRegions.translatedText: and matching couple bracelets for us.

ocrRegions.text: 君開心的事做些讓阿宅
ocrRegions.translatedText: I should do something to make Otaku-kun happy.
